summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily repurchase transactions under its $1 billion stock buyback program, as required by ASX listing rules. The program authorizes open-market purchases of Class A and Class B common shares, with no fixed expiration. No specific price, premium, or advisor is named; the board has previously authorized the program. The filing is procedural, updating the market on execution. Watch for cumulative repurchase volumes and their impact on share count and earnings per share.
